Zoe (People Ops): Short template below 3 fields, copy/paste friendly.
Zoe (People Ops): ```Self-review (5 min)
1) One-line impact: what you shipped and the result (metric if available).
2) Top blocker: one sentence + ask.
3) Skill growth: one concrete area to develop and how (pair, course, project).
4) Teamwork note: one line about collaboration or cross-team help.
```
